title: 第796章 水深嘛第795章 两女机锋
slug: 青铜古舟第802章你惹上事了
content_zh:
云雾湖，占地方圆百里，水面开阔如镜，是沈氏主族后天改造而成。
它不仅是主族领地内最大的水域，更承担着周边数十万亩农田的灌溉之责。
湖水水源来自云峰之巅的积雪融水与地下涌泉的冷泉，两水交汇，清凉透彻，掬一捧入口，甘冽沁脾。
湖岸线蜿蜒曲折，处处是景。
绿树成荫，柳枝垂水，杨树挺拔，银杏金黄，枫叶火红，层林尽染，倒映在湖水中，分不清哪里是岸，哪里是水。
树下百花齐放，菊有黄华，桂子飘香，芙蓉正艳，各色不知名的野花星星点点，像是谁打翻了颜料盒，泼洒在这幅秋日画卷上。
一栋栋木楼亭阁巧妙地与环境融为一体，有的掩映在竹林深处，只露一角飞檐；有的建在水边，凭栏可观鱼；有的藏在枫林中，窗含红叶，门对清波。
楼阁之间以回廊相连，廊下有石桌石凳，供游人歇脚品茶。
湖中有游人泛舟，小舟如叶，散落在碧波之上。有的穿行于莲叶之间，惊起白鹭点点；有的泊在湖心小岛旁，登岛赏景；有的三五成群，舟上摆着酒菜，边饮边行，笑语盈盈。
莲花已谢，莲蓬尚存，枯黄的荷叶低垂着，与碧绿的水面形成鲜明对比。
时有白鹭点水，双翅一展，掠着湖面飞过，爪尖划开一道细细的水痕。
它们不怕生人，有时甚至会落在舟头，歪着脑袋打量船上的人，生性近人，是这片水域最常见的飞禽之一。
沈算一行三人到达湖边时，先行一步的钟源已经很有眼色地租好了一艘小舟。
舟不大，乌篷白帆，舱内铺着竹席，摆着矮桌，桌上还备了茶具和点心。
他见沈算三人走来，也不多说，冲自家少爷挤了挤眼，便拉着冯六开溜了。
“源哥，咱去哪？”冯六被他拽得踉跄。
“去茶棚喝茶，别打扰少爷。”钟源头也不回。
“哦。”冯六回头看了一眼，又转回来，“那……那两位小姐呢？”
“你管那么多干嘛？”钟源没好气地说，“喝茶，喝茶。”
两人一前一后钻进岸边的茶棚，挑了个能看见湖面的位置坐下，要了一壶云雾茶，边喝边远远地瞧着。

湖边，沈算望着那艘小舟，又看了看身旁的两位蒙纱美人，深吸一口气，迈步上船。
“表哥，你会划舟吗？”李雪婷站在岸边，看着沈算拿起竹篙，语气中带着几分怀疑。
“自是会的。”沈算信誓旦旦，竹篙往水里一撑，“莫忘我是本地人，没少来这里玩。”他说得底气十足，仿佛划舟这件事对他来说不过是小儿科。
结果就是当两女轻盈上舟后——某人划动的小船在岸边歪歪扭扭地转了好几个圈，差点撞上旁边的木桩。
舟上，沈算手忙脚乱地调整方向，竹篙左撑一下、右撑一下，好不容易才把小舟弄离了岸边，却划得像一条喝醉了的蛇，在水面上走“之”字。
李雪婷坐在船尾，双手扶着船舷，身体随着小船左右摇晃，面纱下的嘴角微微抽动。
她几次想开口，又忍住了。
文慧怡坐在船头，倒是稳得很，一手扶着船舷，一手轻轻拂过水面，看都不看划船的人，只轻声道：“世兄果真是……本地人。”
沈算听出了那话中的笑意，面不改色：“手生，手生。多年没划了，找找手感。”
过了好一会儿，小船终于不扭了，开始稳稳当当地向前行进。
沈算松了一口气，将竹篙斜插入水，有节奏地划动起来。
“还真是本地人。”李雪婷低声说了一句，语气中带着几分意外。
content_en:
Yunwu Lake covers an area of ​​hundreds of miles and the water surface is as wide as a mirror. It was transformed by the Shen clan.
It is not only the largest body of water in the territory of the main tribe, but also responsible for the irrigation of hundreds of thousands of acres of surrounding farmland.
The water source of the lake comes from the melted snow water on the top of Yunfeng Peak and the cold spring from the underground spring. The two waters meet and are refreshing and refreshing. Take a handful of them and refresh your spleen.
The lake shoreline is winding and full of scenery.
The green trees are shady, the willow branches are hanging down the water, the poplars are tall and straight, the ginkgo trees are golden, the maple leaves are fiery red, and the forest is dyed, reflected in the lake, and it is difficult to tell where is the shore and where is the water.
Hundreds of flowers are in full bloom under the tree, including yellow chrysanthemums, fragrant osmanthus, bright hibiscus, and unknown wild flowers of various colors dotted here and there, as if someone has knocked over the paint box and splashed it on this autumn picture.
The wooden buildings and pavilions are cleverly integrated with the environment. Some are hidden deep in the bamboo forest, with only a corner of the cornice exposed; some are built on the waterside, and you can watch fish by leaning on the railing; some are hidden in the maple forest, with red leaves in the windows and clear waves in the door.
The pavilions are connected by a corridor, and there are stone tables and benches under the corridor for visitors to rest and enjoy tea.
There are tourists boating in the lake, and the boats are like leaves, scattered on the blue waves. Some walked through the lotus leaves, startling egrets; some parked next to the small island in the middle of the lake, and went to the island to enjoy the scenery; some were in groups, with wine and food on the boat, drinking and walking, full of laughter.
The lotus has withered, but the lotus pods are still there, and the withered yellow lotus leaves are hanging low, in sharp contrast with the green water.
From time to time, an egret touches the water, spreads its wings, and flies across the lake, leaving a thin trace of water on the tip of its claws.
They are not afraid of strangers, and sometimes even land on the bow of the boat, tilting their heads to look at the people on the boat. They are friendly by nature and are one of the most common birds in this water area.
When Shen Suan and the other three arrived at the lake, Zhong Yuan, who was one step ahead, had already rented a small boat with a hint.
The boat is small, with a black awning and white sails. The cabin is covered with bamboo mats and a low table. There are tea sets and snacks on the table.
When he saw Shen Suan and the others approaching, he didn't say much, winked at his young master, and pulled Feng Liu away.
"Brother Yuan, where are we going?" Feng Liu was staggered by him.
"Go to the tea shed to drink tea. Don't disturb the young master." Zhong Yuan did not return.
"Oh." Feng Liu glanced back, then back again, "Then...where are the two ladies?"
"Why do you care so much?" Zhong Yuan said angrily, "Drink tea, drink tea."
The two of them got into the tea shed on the shore one after another, chose a place where they could see the lake, and sat down. They ordered a pot of Yunwu tea and drank it while watching it from a distance.
By the lake, Shen Suan looked at the small boat, then at the two veiled beauties beside him, took a deep breath, and stepped onto the boat.
"Cousin, can you row a boat?" Li Xueting stood on the shore, watching Shen Suan pick up the pennies, with a bit of doubt in her tone.
"Of course I can." Shen Suan vowed and pushed his pennies into the water. "Don't forget that I am a local and come here to play often." He said with confidence, as if rowing was nothing more than child's play for him.
The result was that when the two women got into the boat lightly - the boat rowed by someone twisted and turned several times on the shore, almost hitting the wooden pile next to it.
On the boat, Shen Suan adjusted the direction hurriedly, pushing Penny left and right, and finally managed to get the boat away from the shore, but it rowed like a drunk snake, making zigzags on the water.
Li Xueting sat at the stern of the boat, holding the sides of the boat with both hands, her body swaying left and right with the boat, and the corners of her mouth under the veil twitched slightly.
She wanted to speak several times, but held back.
Wen Huiyi was sitting on the bow of the boat, quite stable. She held the side of the boat with one hand and gently brushed the water with the other hand. She didn't even look at the rower and only said softly: "Brother Shi is really... a local."
Shen Suan heard the smile in those words and said without changing his expression: "Hands are good, hands are good. I haven't stroked for many years, let's look for the feeling."
After a while, the boat finally stopped twisting and began to move forward steadily.
Shen Suan breathed a sigh of relief, insert the bamboo pole into the water diagonally, and start paddling rhythmically.
"She is really a local." Li Xueting whispered, with a bit of surprise in her tone.
